name: Conventions page opens from the Skills Lab nav
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, open Skills Lab › Conventions in the sidebar and confirm /repos/<id>/conventions renders its heading and the empty state with the Run extraction call to action. Read-only: never runs an extraction (that is a model call) — the pipeline is covered by server/test/conventions.it.test.ts and the cards/modal by their component tests. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the first repo and has no conventions (the seed creates none).

steps.label: land on the seeded repo's PR list
